title: Teresa Gutiérrez Chacón featured in ICLG coverage of Global Class Actions Symposium
summary: As Spain considers changes to its collective action framework, legal professionals are examining lessons from other jurisdictions and the implications for cross-border litigation. ICLG reports on discussions at the Global Class Actions Symposium in Madrid, featuring Burford Senior Vice President Teresa Gutiérrez Chacón, who participated in a panel on Big Tech disputes. Learn more.
body_markdown:
As Spain considers changes to its collective action framework, legal professionals are examining lessons from other jurisdictions and the implications for cross-border litigation. *ICLG* reports on discussions at the Global Class Actions Symposium in Madrid, featuring Burford Senior Vice President[Teresa Gutiérrez Chacón](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/teresa-gutierrez-chacon/) , who participated in a panel on Big Tech disputes.


Read the full article[here](https://iclg.com/news/class-actions-royalty-comes-to-madrid/) .
